common.definition_note: Seasonally and calendar adjusted real GDP q/q growth in non-annualised percent; Eurostat CLV_PCH_PRE.
Eurostat une_rt_m age=TOTAL; EU/EA series are harmonised LFS-based indicators, while non-EU passthrough countries retain provider definitions and flags.
